Follow the Conventional Commits specification (type(scope): subject). Use a scope only when it adds clarity (e.g., feat(parser): ...). Use one of the standard types unless instructed otherwise: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert. Keep the subject line concise, imperative, and 72 characters or fewer for each change. Do not capitalise the first word of the subject and do not end it with a period. Write the subject to describe what the change does, not what was done (“add X”, not “added X”). If staging contains multiple items, thats ok, write them on multiple lines.
